library.name: Littlewild core library
library.description: Core items, recipes, lessons and buildings. The World library defines resource supply, workplace inventories and tending in v8. Data-only definitions for external authoring.

skills.name: Woodland hands
skills.desc: Learn to collect fallen branches and harvest wood. The beginning of something bigger.
skills.unlocks: Gather wood · Build a workbench

skills.name: A place of our own
skills.desc: Turn branches and woven leaves into a safe, dry place to sleep.
skills.unlocks: Build a leaf shelter · Build a learning circle

skills.name: Stone sense
skills.desc: Spot useful stones and carefully work them free of the hillside.
skills.unlocks: Gather stone

skills.name: A little spark
skills.desc: Build and tend a cozy campfire. Warm paws, brighter evenings.
skills.unlocks: Build a campfire · Warm up

skills.name: Green paws
skills.desc: Grow a renewable patch of berries. A little planning makes tomorrow gentler.
skills.unlocks: Build a berry garden · Build a grain patch · Gather wild grain

skills.name: Grain & patience
skills.desc: Shape two pieces of wood into a plank at a workbench.
skills.unlocks: Craft planks · More ambitious buildings

skills.name: Something delicious
skills.desc: Cook two berries, one water and one wild meat into two hearty meals at a campfire.
skills.unlocks: Cook hearty meals

skills.name: Reading the wild
skills.desc: Follow trails into the meadow and return with provisions. Hunting is shown as a gentle, off-screen expedition.
skills.unlocks: Hunt for provisions

skills.name: Hello, neighbor
skills.desc: Build a place to meet travelers. Buy necessities with an allowance and fill neighborhood requests.
skills.unlocks: Build a market · Buy supplies · Deliveries

skills.name: Well made
skills.desc: Build a well for fresh water close to home. Less walking, more living.
skills.unlocks: Build a well

skills.name: Dream a little bigger
skills.desc: Build a proper cottage from planks and stone. A warm new chapter for two old friends.
skills.unlocks: Build a woodland cottage

skills.name: Bright little ideas
skills.desc: Build a study nook. Curious afternoon experiments earn shared research points.
skills.unlocks: Build a study nook · Research autonomously

skills.name: A thread to follow
skills.unlocks: Twist rope at a workbench · More useful structures
skills.desc: Turn loose plant fibers into a dependable length of rope.

skills.name: Earth between our paws
skills.unlocks: Gather clay · Prepare for pottery
skills.desc: Recognize the soft clay deposits beside the spring.

skills.name: Something soft, something strong
skills.unlocks: Build a loom · Weave cloth
skills.desc: A little thread becomes a blanket, an awning or a greenhouse shade.

skills.name: A shape that stays
skills.unlocks: Build a kiln · Fire bricks and pots
skills.desc: Clay becomes something lasting with a careful amount of heat.

skills.name: The helpful little leaves
skills.unlocks: Gather herbs · Build an herbarium · Make soothing balm
skills.desc: Recognize helpful plants and prepare a comforting balm.

skills.name: Stronger at the seams
skills.unlocks: Make timber beams · Build a workshop
skills.desc: Join planks and cordage into a frame that can carry bigger dreams.

skills.name: A patient kind of fire
skills.unlocks: Gather ore · Build a smelter · Smelt iron · Make tools
skills.desc: Transform ore and charcoal into iron, then put it to useful work.

skills.name: A greener tomorrow
skills.unlocks: Build a greenhouse · Improve garden yields
skills.desc: Combine a dependable water supply and a protected growing space.

skills.name: When the wind helps
skills.unlocks: Build a windmill · Mill grain into flour
skills.desc: The glade grows grain. A turning sail makes it useful.

skills.name: The smell of coming home

skills.desc: Mix flour and water, then let a good oven do its part.

skills.name: A place for every possibility

skills.desc: An orderly storehouse saves steps around the workshops.

skills.name: Learning how to learn
skills.unlocks: Improve the learning circle · Better coached practice
skills.desc: Patient teaching and a comfortable place make new ideas stick.

skills.name: A little world in motion
skills.unlocks: Build a waterwheel · Upgrade advanced workshops
skills.desc: Let a turning wheel do some of the work. Nearby stations benefit.

buildings.name: Leaf shelter
buildings.desc: A safe little nest. Better sleep and comfort.
buildings.effect: Rest restores 60 energy and 24 comfort.

buildings.name: Workbench
buildings.desc: A place to turn resources into possibilities.

buildings.name: Campfire
buildings.desc: Warm paws. Stories. A light to come home to.

buildings.effect: A tended herb bed supplied with carried water. Herbs wait locally for collection.

buildings.name: Storehouse
buildings.effect: Crafting stations within 4 tiles work 12% faster.
buildings.desc: Every useful thing has a place; every trip can be a little shorter.

buildings.effect: Must be near the spring. Stations within 4 tiles work 18% faster.

buildings.effect: Autonomous research yields +2 shared points. Lessons are 10% faster.

buildings.desc: A sturdy table for shared charts, island invitations and the next bridge. Build it to open the world map.
buildings.effect: A completed, reachable map table opens the world map. Island purchases still require land research, guide levels, coins and prestige.
